verdict.rationale: Stripe docs confirm proration previews and applied changes on subscription upgrades/downgrades (stripe-billing-docs-4), and invoicing/customization exists (stripe-billing-docs-8, docs-26), but there is no documented detail on the underlying proration math, credit-note reconciliation logic, or auditable line-item breakdowns finance teams would need to reconcile to the penny; community evidence is silent on proration accuracy specifically. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of proration formula/rounding rules, credit note audit trail specifics, and independent/hands-on verification that invoice line items reconcile exactly.
